source: Daily_Check.docx (trimmed list). Crossed-out questions are not included.

rules.empty_text_note: If N/A, none, or similar is in a text box, it does not count as filled, so a 'filled' question earns 0.
rules.domain_note: 'general' (D0) is mandatory for every patient. The other six (D1-D6) are optional and switched on per patient by the admin.

grading_types.yes_no_inverted: No = 1 point, Yes = 0 (yes is the unwanted answer).
grading_types.filled: 1 point if the text box has a real answer (not empty / N/A). Content is not judged.
grading_types.selected: 1 point if an option is selected.

questions.text: How confident am I that I can accomplish this goal today (0-10)?
questions.open_question: Not marked 'graded' in the doc, so not scored. The mandatory domain therefore has no graded questions; change 'grading' here to score it.

questions.text: Did I meet my goal today?
questions.open_question: Not marked 'graded' in the doc, so not scored. To score it, set grading to 'choice_map' (uses option_scores).

questions.text: How content were you today? (0-10)
questions.open_question: Not marked 'graded' in the doc, so not scored. The mandatory domain therefore has no graded questions; change 'grading' here to score it.

questions.text: What is my step target today?
What is one fun activity I can do that will get my body moving for at least 10 minutes?
Did I reach my step target today?
How did I feel after reaching my step target?
Did I complete another physical activity today?
questions.note: The grade comes from PA-E2a being filled in, not from this answer.

questions.text: Briefly record what I did and for how long.
How did I feel afterward?
What is one specific nutrition goal I want to accomplish today?
What did I eat today?
What nutrition choice am I happy with today?
Did I have difficulty following my plan today?
questions.open_question: Added by us: the doc says 'if yes, do a check box list', which implies a yes/no question first. Confirm wording.

questions.text: What contributed to it?
Will I practice mindfulness today?
Where will it take place?
When will it take place?
How long?
How calm or alert do I feel right now on a scale of 0-10?
questions.open_question: Assumed higher = better (10 earns full points).

questions.text: Did I go to bed at the time I set up for myself last night?
questions.note: Answered in the morning, but counts toward the day before. Can show last night's planned bedtime from SL-M3.

questions.text: What time do I want to begin winding down tonight?
What time do I plan to get into bed?
Who is one person I would like to connect with today?
Did I connect with the person I said I would?
questions.note: Only shown if this morning's SC-M1 was filled in; the app can show the name.

questions.text: Did I feel…
Did my interactions today make me feel…
Did I avoid social contact today?
questions.open_question: Assumed 'No' (didn't avoid) is the good answer.

questions.text: If so, what thoughts or feelings contributed to that decision?
What is my substance-use goal today?
Do you plan to attend a meeting today?
What is my specific limit or plan?

If I used, what situations contributed?
What emotions contributed?
What triggers contributed?
